hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/lyman-run-state-park/stay ('Twenty-nine campsites have electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880115 (all 29 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp; none lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 35 RV and tent campsites in the Daggett Run and Lower campgrounds, 29 with electricity and 6 walk-ins. The booking site lists the 29 Modern Electric drive-in sites plus 6 tent-only. Listed max vehicle lengths run 32-80 ft, most 40-70 ft; sites 001, 019 and 032 list 106, 112 and 134 ft (the same as their driveway lengths), left out of max_rig_ft. Five pull-throughs (19, 20, 21, 28, 33).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lyman-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880115 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Modern shower houses in both campgrounds; the dump station is in the Lower Campground. The booking page lists the nearest camp store and laundromat as outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/lyman-run-state-park/stay ('modern shower houses with hot water, flush toilets, and showers. A sanitary dump station is in the Lower Campground') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880115 ('Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground', 'Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lyman-run-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880115 (Booking Window for Modern Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric at all 29 RV sites (no water/sewer), 29 drive-in sites to ~80 ft with 5 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump, no camp store or laundry on site. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, drinking water. Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): stored 'not waterfront'. ReserveAmerica lists 'Proximity to Waterfront: Less than 300 feet' on 17 of the 29 electric sites (none 'Waterfront'). Under 300 ft is not frontage; only worth a look if the pads sit on Lyman Run or the lake.
